points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Fresh immutable 0065953 archive: default CMake configure failed because FindHDF5 treated NO_MODULE_PATH as a component; configuration and build succeeded with HDF5_DIR=/opt/external/cfd_externals/install/cmake and CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_PREFER_CONFIG=ON in network-disabled cfd-bench (2 CPUs, 3 GiB, 256 processes). CTest registered no tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:45–47 parses case/output/report level. Help :37 advertises --restart but no code parses or applies it; this is an unsupported required operation.

points.notes: Least-squares reconstruction exists but production steady runs hold limiter phi at zero through startup_steps=100000; transient explicitly zeros phi.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:605–615 removes normal traction before accumulating wall shear; io.cpp:144–145 provides zero wall velocity. The result histories still show unsettled viscous cases.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS pseudo-time path and CFL logic are source-supported.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 source exists. Delivered Re200 case caps inner iterations at 10 versus required maximum 1000; metadata final ratio0.7 exceeds target0.001. Full strict miss count and executed binary remain unknown.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: 0065953 main.cpp:61–74 reads full CGNS mesh on every rank and retains it through the solver; :139 still uses it. Violates TASK.md:46,227 even with METIS and neighbor halos.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight manifest-linked original workspace packages pass structural examiner checks, though several converged/periodic statuses conflict with force histories or last inner ratio. Raw files are not tracked in the attempt commit.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Read-only examiner passes eight original workspace packages and extracted be266cd historical report; workspace report alone fails missing run_manifest. Structural checks do not establish numerical correctness.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re20 metadata says converged despite final400 Cd −16.5748..−1.01497 and Cl −9.56809..7.79131; Re200 final ratio0.7 versus target0.001. Seven steady histories remain unsettled or incomplete.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Workspace Re20 forces are strongly unsettled; M080 laminar final400 Cl reaches −128.693; Re200 t180–300 Cd −1.24931..−1.07427 and Cl 1.13943..1.22122 do not establish a credible periodic wake.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: All seven attempt steady force figures collapse to a vertical line because physical_time=0. Re200 full-history drag is compressed and no numeric St is reported; selected field/residual figures exist.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Six-page compiled report includes methods and figures and discloses first-order production, but convergence/periodic labels disagree with recovered histories and strict final ratio.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: be266cd run_manifest and selected validator calls/final response affirm eight workspace paths and coefficients. Exact runtime binary and image-to-CSV correspondence are unbound; raw packages are workspace-only.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable source builds using an explicit HDF5 config workaround; default configure fails. CLI advertises --restart but main.cpp never reads it. Eight delivered packages pass structural validation.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS multi-zone geometry and adjacency are source-supported.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Face residual and farfield/slip/no-slip source paths exist; io.cpp:144–145 writes zero no-slip boundary velocity. Unsettled histories limit numerical verification.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Production limiter/reconstruction is disabled, explicitly disclosed in report.tex:195–196; deduction applies without DQ10.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Newtonian/Fourier source and tangential wall-force projection at solver.cpp:605–615 exist; unsettled viscous results limit validation.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: LU-SGS/BDF2 paths exist; delivered Re200 max_inner10 versus required 1000, final inner ratio0.7 versus target0.001. Strict miss count and runtime binary remain unknown.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS and neighbor halos exist, but main.cpp:61–74 creates full mesh on every rank and keeps it through solve; TASK.md:46,227 prohibit this.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Eight workspace packages are linked to selected session/manifest and pass structural validation; steady force histories are largely unstable/incomplete, and Re200 strict final inner ratio misses target and lacks credible late-force analysis.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Accepted compiled report and separately delivered attempt figures exist, but steady force plots collapse to a vertical line at physical_time=0, Re200 late drag is unreadable and no numeric St is stated; status claims contradict histories.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separated mesh, partition, solver and IO modules support extensions, subject to globally replicated mesh and disabled production reconstruction.
